notes.title: A new game in development
notes.notes:
Immortals Shattered World, currently available as a pre-alpha here [url=https://duhprey.itch.io/immortals-shattered-worlds]https://duhprey.itch.io/immortals-shattered-worlds[/url] is in development with an expected early-access in beta to Steam sometime in 2022.

Follow now on Itch to get in early and get insider access to the development.

notes.title: Release date coming soon
notes.notes:
After much tinkering with the mechanics and twiddling with the bits, we feel ready to come out of early access and release upon the world.

News about the release date coming soon.

notes.title: Longshot Universe Early Access Release Date
notes.notes:
Hi there,

Our plan at this point is to release LSU on Tuesday, April 25th just before Midnight Pacific Coast Time.

Please tell your friends and get in the fight together!  We look forward to seeing everyone online!

-- Longshot Studios.
